projects.name: From concept to shipped AI product
projects.description: Led a team of three through product discovery and six rapid product-vision iterations to ship an AI developer-tools product, and set up an AI-assisted workflow that speeds up every delivery cycle.

projects.name: Leaner AI for medical imaging
projects.description: Designed a compact CNN architecture and a more efficient attention mechanism, so clinical models get more accurate while needing less compute.

projects.name: A government-grade platform, delivered
projects.description: Led planning, design and delivery of three projects, including a multi-tenant platform where every region runs as a legally separate entity, with faster responses on the busiest requests.

projects.name: Turning around a stalled e-commerce business
projects.description: Resolved a year-long deadlock between a national clothing franchise and its development agency, took over the infrastructure and migrated the store to a platform the business could rely on.

projects.name: Co-founding and shipping a product
projects.description: Co-founded the company and built its role-based platform and mobile apps, making the product feel instant and catching crashes before users report them.

projects.name: Reviving a stalled patent project
projects.description: Completed a computer-vision project that had stalled for two years, with a homography-free marker detection algorithm fast enough for real time.
